facts.fact: 邮递员 Greg 送来一个包裹，章首句「Not all deer are good animals」与 ch26 呼应
facts.anchor: The post came today. The postman is Greg. He brought a parcel.

facts.fact: 邮包收件人是 Arthur Sanderson——男主意识到邮递员把他当成了那个人
他犹豫了：收下 Arthur 的衣服、家具、兴趣之前什么都没发生，收下他的名字会发生什么
facts.anchor: For a moment he hesitated. Should he accept the parcel?

facts.fact: 他用指尖签了一个谁也认不出的潦草签名——既不是自己也不是 Arthur 的名字
他穿上 Arthur 的冬装时，衣柜里 Caroline 的声音哀求「求你，Arthur，让我进来」
照片里白发老人正是他第一夜在厨房窗口见过的鬼影——恐怖从幻象变成档案
facts.anchor: It was the old man he’d seen that first night through the kitchen window.

facts.fact: Dr Benn 的信警告 Arthur：你在 Firefleet 处于危险之中，不知道你留下来会释放什么力量
facts.anchor: You are in danger at Firefleet. You have no idea what forces you may be unleashing by staying there.

facts.fact: 雾里一只鹿以近乎捕食的姿态撕咬一只死羊——章首「Not all deer are good animals」应验
facts.anchor: No deer would eat a dead sheep. And yet, that’s what it looked like; the sheep’s woolly back; the deer’s movements strangely aggressive – almost predatory – as it tore at the pale patch at its feet.
